messages:
Priya (PM): mockup dropped — https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/quickstart-v2
Priya (PM): quick question: toast vs persistent shelf for quickstart? need copy + a11y check. goal is lower first-run dropoff. thoughts?

Elaine (Designer): shelf gives better discoverability and can hold sample picker. toast easy to miss/dismiss. shelf can collapse.

Sam (Devex): shelf is fine if it doesn't push critical actions offscreen on small viewports. could collapse to a small pill on mobile.

Mike (Frontend): technically doable — we have a /ui/rail that we can adapt. note: persistent shelf needs per-workspace persisted state. perf shouldn't be an issue.

Sofia (Accessibility): quick a11y nits from mock: label text on sample cards fails AA contrast at 12px (ratio < 4.5:1). also DOM order puts the dismiss X after primary CTA — that breaks expected focus order.

Marcus (Eng): fyi we should gate showing any persistent onboarding until after telemetry prefs shown/accepted. privacy-first. also add a feature flag so we can roll back.

Elaine (Designer): copy thoughts: root line: 'Start with a sample project' feels heavy. what about 'Try a sample project' (lighter). CTA options: 'Open sample' vs 'Use sample' vs 'Start building'.

Priya (PM): I like 'Try a sample project' + primary CTA 'Open sample', secondary 'Skip for now'. keep verbs light.

Sam (Devex): analytics events to add: quickstart_shown, quickstart_cta_opened, quickstart_cta_skipped. include variant field: toast|shelf. will add to tracking doc.

design-bot: reminder — run axe CI and keyboard navigation smoke locally before merging.

Mike (Frontend): small CSS idea for responsive collapse:
```css
.quickstart-shelf { position: sticky; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 30; }
@media (max-width: 640px) { .quickstart-shelf { transform: translateY(55%); border-radius: 12px; width: 320px; margin: 0 auto; } }
```

Sofia (Accessibility): also flag: if shelf is sticky, ensure it never traps keyboard focus and doesn't occlude the last focusable element on page. announce with aria-live="polite" when it appears.

Marcus (Eng): implementing telemetry gating + feature flag. will coordinate with Sam on event names.

Priya (PM): action items: Elaine update copy + contrast tokens; Mike adjust DOM order + responsive pill; Sam add analytics & variant flag; Sofia re-run a11y tests; Marcus add feature flag + gating. target: Wed EOD for updated frames and PRs. :thumbsup:

Elaine (Designer): on it — will post updated frames tomorrow with contrast numbers and alt copy variants.

Sam (Devex): tracking doc updated: https://notion.so/redwood/quickstart-tracking (added events + variant param).

Sofia (Accessibility): quick note — confirm color tokens, don't hardcode hex; use semantic tokens so contrast stays consistent across themes.

Mike (Frontend): noted re: DOM order. I can flip elements and add aria attributes. will open draft PR by Tue.

Priya (PM): great — thanks everyone. we'll A/B toast vs shelf in a small segment after internal testing.

Marcus (Eng): will emit rollout plan in the feature flag ticket.

design-bot: added checklist to PR template: a11y checks, analytics, feature-flagged rollout.

Priya (PM): closing thread — ping if anything blocks.
